title: Consultant Neurosurgeon
summary: Mahayogi Gorakhnath University, Gorakhpur invites applications for the position of Consultant Neurosurgeon on a regular or contractual basis. Eligible candidates with relevant medical degrees and registrations may apply by sending their resume via email before the deadline.
eligibility_bullets: Possess MBBS, MS (General Surgery) & M.Ch. (Neurosurgery) or DNB (Neurosurgery) from a recognized medical institution.
Hold a valid registration with the National Medical Commission (NMC) or State Medical Council.
Demonstrate sound clinical knowledge and expertise in neurological and neurosurgical care.
how_to_apply_steps: Prepare a detailed resume with all supporting documents.
Mention the subject of the email as 'Application for Neurosurgeon'.
Send the application via email to hr.head@mgug.ac.in on or before 05th December, 2026.
